raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Madam Ch'en, I believe Amiya is right next to you. Can you hear me?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Madam Ch'en, I believe Amiya is right next to you. Can you hear me?

speaker: Amiya
content: Yes, Chief Wei.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Very well then.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  I must apologize, leader of Rhodes Island. Though I can risk sending the L.G.D. deep into enemy territory, I can't risk bringing any more players into this game.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: I must apologize, leader of Rhodes Island. Though I can risk sending the L.G.D. deep into enemy territory, I can't risk bringing any more players into this game.

raw: [Decision(options="Bringing more players in?;...What do you mean by that?;The situation out there is already chaotic.", values="1;2;3")]
options: Bringing more players in?;...What do you mean by that?;The situation out there is already chaotic.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Dr. {@nickname}...

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Beneath this entire land lies an invisible, yet intricate net.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Beneath this entire land lies an invisible, yet intricate net.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  No single city can break free from this net of conspiracy and intrigue - and especially not Lungmen, as it is situated in the midsts of giants.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: No single city can break free from this net of conspiracy and intrigue - and especially not Lungmen, as it is situated in the midsts of giants.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Perhaps you already know this, perhaps you don't. Nevertheless, I have to take all these factors into consideration.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Perhaps you already know this, perhaps you don't. Nevertheless, I have to take all these factors into consideration.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Chief Wei, you should have shared this information with us if you wanted our mission to progress more smoothly.
speaker: Amiya
content: Chief Wei, you should have shared this information with us if you wanted our mission to progress more smoothly.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  At least, you should have told me.
speaker: Amiya
content: At least, you should have told me.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  I must apologize yet again, Miss Amiya. From my position, I simply cannot disclose all our intel.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: I must apologize yet again, Miss Amiya. From my position, I simply cannot disclose all our intel.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  If you were standing in my shoes, you would have made the same decision.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: If you were standing in my shoes, you would have made the same decision.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  What happened in the Chernobog ruins was a pity, but at least you achieved something.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: What happened in the Chernobog ruins was a pity, but at least you achieved something.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  You used us to draw Reunion's attention.
speaker: Blaze
content: You used us to draw Reunion's attention.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  No, the L.G.D. was right there with you.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: No, the L.G.D. was right there with you.

raw: [Decision(options="You used all of us as bait.", values="1")]
options: You used all of us as bait.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Huh?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  He planned for all this a long time ago.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: He planned for all this a long time ago.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Reunion's infiltration only deepens as time passes, so he had to quickly make a decision.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Reunion's infiltration only deepens as time passes, so he had to quickly make a decision.

raw: [Decision(options="At the most crucial moment, when Reunion was most vulnerable...", values="1")]
options: At the most crucial moment, when Reunion was most vulnerable...

raw: [Decision(options="Rhodes Island was made to draw their attention.", values="1")]
options: Rhodes Island was made to draw their attention.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  He led Reunion to believe that the L.G.D. had been separated—
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: He led Reunion to believe that the L.G.D. had been separated—

raw: [Decision(options="...and fooled them into thinking that Lungmen was undefended.", values="1")]
options: ...and fooled them into thinking that Lungmen was undefended.

raw: [CharacterCutin(widgetID="1", name="char_2005_weiyw_1", style="cutin", fadestyle= "horiz_expand_center", fadetime=0.5, offsetx=-300, width=200, block=true)]
name: char_2005_weiyw_1

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Hah, well said, Dr. {@nickname}! Chief, of course you'd need us to hold Reunion back. The more the better, right?
speaker: Blaze
content: Hah, well said, Dr. {@nickname}! Chief, of course you'd need us to hold Reunion back. The more the better, right?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  When the lurking Reunion saw Lungmen in such a state, there's no way they wouldn't spring at the opportunity.
speaker: Blaze
content: When the lurking Reunion saw Lungmen in such a state, there's no way they wouldn't spring at the opportunity.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  And as soon as they began to emerge from their lairs, then BAM! Lungmen's elite forces would be waiting for them, seemingly out of nowhere.
speaker: Blaze
content: And as soon as they began to emerge from their lairs, then BAM! Lungmen's elite forces would be waiting for them, seemingly out of nowhere.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  How long have you been concealing Lungmen's power? Did you already start preparing for this after the Chernobog incident?
speaker: Blaze
content: How long have you been concealing Lungmen's power? Did you already start preparing for this after the Chernobog incident?

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Lungmen kept you safe, and helped you return to a position that could maximize your value.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Lungmen kept you safe, and helped you return to a position that could maximize your value.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  You left Amiya to die back there in the middle of so many enemies. What kind of 'position' are you talking about?
speaker: Blaze
content: You left Amiya to die back there in the middle of so many enemies. What kind of 'position' are you talking about?

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  I just hope that Rhodes Island can understand that we all have to face this difficult situation together.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: I just hope that Rhodes Island can understand that we all have to face this difficult situation together.

speaker: Amiya
content: Miss Blaze, Dr. {@nickname}, it's fine.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Miss Swire helped us to defeat Reunion's forces, together. Lungmen did not abandon us.
speaker: Amiya
content: Miss Swire helped us to defeat Reunion's forces, together. Lungmen did not abandon us.

speaker: Amiya
content: (We don't have any proof.)

speaker: Blaze
content: Tch...

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Our agreement is still valid. No matter what happened during the process, only the end result can satisfy me.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Our agreement is still valid. No matter what happened during the process, only the end result can satisfy me.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: No matter what happened.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island, I believe I made myself clear the last time we met.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island, I believe I made myself clear the last time we met.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  You do not have a choice in this matter. But at least you can choose how you eliminate your enemies.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: You do not have a choice in this matter. But at least you can choose how you eliminate your enemies.

raw: [Decision(options="I don't believe you or the snake oil you peddle.;...;Nobody will happily smile and go on their way after being deceived.", values="1;2;3")]
options: I don't believe you or the snake oil you peddle.;...;Nobody will happily smile and go on their way after being deceived.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Isn't that for the best?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Isn't that for the best?

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  We should all stay alert. Nobody should let their guard down when we are facing a common enemy.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: We should all stay alert. Nobody should let their guard down when we are facing a common enemy.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Your vigilance can keep you from falling into a trap.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Your vigilance can keep you from falling into a trap.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Listen, Dr. {@nickname}—

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  ...We may not be friends yet, but at least we are not enemies.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: ...We may not be friends yet, but at least we are not enemies.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  So, silence is your answer.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: So, silence is your answer.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  A fine display of judgment. You would hide your weaknesses while pressing your advantages.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: A fine display of judgment. You would hide your weaknesses while pressing your advantages.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Rhodes Island indeed is a powerful partner. You have earned my recognition from this incident.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Rhodes Island indeed is a powerful partner. You have earned my recognition from this incident.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  But, this comes on the condition that our relationship is still a partnership, not a statement of the status between illegal Infected and local authorities.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: But, this comes on the condition that our relationship is still a partnership, not a statement of the status between illegal Infected and local authorities.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  I do not intend to fool anyone.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: I do not intend to fool anyone.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Though, objectively speaking, I may well have fooled Reunion.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Though, objectively speaking, I may well have fooled Reunion.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  But none of that can be proven. Reunion may also have access to our secrets.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: But none of that can be proven. Reunion may also have access to our secrets.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  We can only hope to destroy them before they come to grasp our strategies.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: We can only hope to destroy them before they come to grasp our strategies.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  So, does this goal motivate you at all?
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: So, does this goal motivate you at all?

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Miss Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}, the cooperation between us has not ended yet.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Miss Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}, the cooperation between us has not ended yet.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  A counterattack is imminent. We will demonstrate Lungmen's stature, wisdom, and unity to them.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: A counterattack is imminent. We will demonstrate Lungmen's stature, wisdom, and unity to them.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  If possible, I would also like to witness Rhodes Island's professionalism, resolve, and bravery.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: If possible, I would also like to witness Rhodes Island's professionalism, resolve, and bravery.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  In fifteen minutes, Madam Ch'en will return to fight at your side.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: In fifteen minutes, Madam Ch'en will return to fight at your side.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Mister Wei, I hope you don't forget what you just said.
speaker: Amiya
content: Mister Wei, I hope you don't forget what you just said.

speaker: Amiya
content: Because Rhodes Island will not.

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: Naturally.

speaker: Amiya
content: Blaze, Dr. {@nickname}, let's go.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Ah, by the way, Madam Ch'en, where's Inspector Hoshiguma? I don't see her around. Is she... all right?
speaker: Amiya
content: Ah, by the way, Madam Ch'en, where's Inspector Hoshiguma? I don't see her around. Is she... all right?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  She had some minor injuries, nothing serious.
speaker: Ch'en
content: She had some minor injuries, nothing serious.

speaker: Amiya
content: Oh, I see...

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Madam Ch'en, Rhodes Island can also give you a checkup and provide some quick treatment if needed.
speaker: Amiya
content: Madam Ch'en, Rhodes Island can also give you a checkup and provide some quick treatment if needed.

speaker: Ch'en
content: No thanks.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  You don't have to worry about anything, our medical procedures are completely confidential.
speaker: Amiya
content: You don't have to worry about anything, our medical procedures are completely confidential.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  A little bit of elbow grease is good enough.
speaker: Ch'en
content: A little bit of elbow grease is good enough.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Mm... If you insist, then I won't force you.
speaker: Amiya
content: Mm... If you insist, then I won't force you.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  In that case, I'll see you later then, Madam Ch'en.
speaker: Amiya
content: In that case, I'll see you later then, Madam Ch'en.

content: Chief Wei, how was everything on your end?

content: Good, of course. Otherwise, I wouldn't have time to chat with you here.

raw: [name="Swire"]  Did they agree to slow down the operation?
speaker: Swire
content: Did they agree to slow down the operation?

content: Of course, but there is a time limit.

content: I want you to take care of everything within a day.

speaker: Swire
content: Chief Wei, if they can help us, we can get rid of Reunion within hours. Wouldn't that minimize our losses?

speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: That's not important. Lungmen should be able to handle its own problems, once and for all. That is our first principle.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  That is what we need to demonstrate to them. So, everyone, get moving.
speaker: Wei Yenwu
content: That is what we need to demonstrate to them. So, everyone, get moving.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Go, Madam Ch'en. It is time to show Reunion some Lungmen hospitality.

speaker: Ch'en
content: Understood.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  Chief Wei, I do have one question. Even if you can't answer right now, I hope you can give me a reasonable guess after everything is over.

content: This is supposed to be Reunion's all-out attack. In that case, why has their leader, Talulah, not appeared in Lungmen?

content: I thought things were progressing smoothly. Why are you frowning, then?

content: Have we received any response from Ursus?

speaker: Fumizuki
content: Still nothing.

raw: [name="Wei Yenwu"]  Fumizuki, I have a premonition. That this whole thing is just the start of something much bigger.

content: The last time I heard you say that was many years ago.

content: When did I say that? I've completely forgotten why I would say something like that.

content: That was right after we first met. Are you saying that you've forgotten about everything that's ever happened between us?

content: N-no way! How could I! I just can't remember most things apart from our time together.

speaker: Fumizuki
content: Nice try, you sweet-talker. Unfortunately, this isn't something you'll be able to forget.

content: You said this to my face twenty years ago... that if we lost, this city would be under a different name, and become just another stepping stone on the path to Ursus hegemony.

raw: [name="Fumizuki"]  If we had lost, you wouldn't be the one sitting here. He would.

content: If we had lost, you wouldn't be the one sitting here. He would.

raw: [name="Fumizuki"]  Alas, poor Tal. Don't you think she reminds us of him?
speaker: Fumizuki
content: Alas, poor Tal. Don't you think she reminds us of him?

content: But he's already dead.
